base_url.description: URL path where the webmail is accessible (e.g., /webmail/). Must begin with '/' and not end with '/' unless root.

template_dir.description: Absolute path to the directory containing Jinja2 templates.

static_dir.description: Absolute path to the directory containing static assets (CSS, JS, images).

log_level.description: Logging verbosity. Choose from DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL.

log_file.description: Path to log file. Leave empty ('') to log only to stdout/stderr.

imap.description: IMAP server connection settings for fetching mail.

host.description: IMAP server hostname or IP address.

port.description: IMAP port (typically 143 for STARTTLS, 993 for IMAPS).

use_tls.description: If true, attempt STARTTLS upgrade after connecting (port 143).

use_ssl.description: If true, use SSL/TLS from the start (IMAPS on port 993).

auth_method.description: IMAP auth mechanism. Supported: LOGIN, PLAIN, CRAM-MD5.

secret_key.description: Cryptographically secure random key for session signing and encryption. Must be unique per deployment and kept secret.

session_cookie_path.description: Path scope of the session cookie.

session_cookie_domain.description: Domain scope of the cookie. Leave blank to auto-detect from request.

session_timeout.description: Session lifetime in seconds. After this period of inactivity, the session expires.

secure_cookie.description: If true, the session cookie is only sent over HTTPS (recommended in production).

inbox_folder.description: Default IMAP folder displayed on login. Common alternatives: 'INBOX', 'INBOX/Inbox'.

folder_separator.description: Character used to separate folder hierarchy levels (e.g., '.' for GMail, '/' for Dovecot).

messages_per_page.description: Number of messages to show per page in message list views.

max_recipients_displayed.description: Maximum number of recipients (To/Cc/Bcc) shown before truncating with 'and X others'.

hidden_folders.description: List of IMAP folder names to hide from the folder listing UI.

smtp.description: SMTP relay configuration for sending outbound mail.

port.description: SMTP port (25 for direct, 465 for SSL, 587 for STARTTLS).

use_tls.description: If true, initiate STARTTLS after connecting (port 587).

use_ssl.description: If true, use SSL/TLS from start (port 465).

username.description: SMTP username for authentication. Leave blank for unauthenticated relay.

password.description: SMTP password for authentication. Leave blank for unauthenticated relay.

helo_hostname.description: Hostname to present in HELO/EHLO. Defaults to server's hostname.

theme.description: Name of the UI theme to apply (must exist under static_dir/themes/).

language.description: Default language tag (BCP 47). Fallback if user has no language preference.

auto_detect_language.description: If true, attempt to detect user language from HTTP Accept-Language headers.

plugins.description: Plugin configuration. 'enabled' lists plugin names; 'configs' defines per-plugin settings.

enabled.description: List of plugin names to load (e.g., ['auth_ldap']).

configs.description: Per-plugin configuration blocks. Each object defines a plugin name and its key-value settings.

name.description: Plugin name, used as section header (e.g., 'auth_ldap').
